Hey! I’m looking for a model to join me for a relaxed street photography shoot in London. All experience levels are welcome!

If you’ve already applied to my previous listing, you don’t need to apply again. That listing expired, but I still have your application.

The plan is to wander around a few streets and capture natural, casual portraits with a street style feel. I’m thinking East London, as it tends to be quieter during the week, but I’m happy to hear your location suggestions and creative ideas. If you need some headshots, we can work those in too.

This is an unpaid collaboration, and you’ll receive photos from the shoot to use for your portfolio and social media. The whole shoot will take place outdoors or in public spaces.

Please note that I fit these shoots around work, and they always take place during the daytime. We can agree on a date and location that work for us both.

If you’re interested, drop me a message! Feel free to send over any ideas or inspiration from Pinterest, Instagram or wherever you’ve spotted something you’d like to try.

If your application is approved, please keep an eye on your messages. I’ll send you my availability so we can arrange a shoot.

Thanks!
